meta.title: Recreate Order is offered on an RFQ whose bidding has ended and is in its evaluation time

plan.title: Recreate Order Available During RFQ Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ event already in evaluation on the buyer side.
Verify Recreate Order is present and clickable in the current stage Settings menu.
Select Recreate Order to open its window without confirming any changes.
Confirm the Recreate Order window opened.
Cancel the window so no order recreation is committed.
Confirm the Recreate Order window closed after cancellation.
